description.text: The seven levels are as the following: Elementary 1, Elementary 2, Elementary 3; Intermediate 1, Intermediate 2; Advanced 1, Advanced 2 Enrollment Students will take part in the placement test to decide which class level to enroll. School time Spring semester, deadline of application is Jan. 15th Fall semester, deadline of application is July 15th

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Program at Qingdao University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education 5. Certificate of employment or education Students still at school should provide school attendance certificate, graduates who have a job should provide working certificate. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese. 6. Resume Written in Chinese and English

requirements.text: 1. Aged 16 years old or above 2. Be in good health 3. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university;
